bio: Situated in an attractive location on the seafront promenade in Portorož, this restaurant boasts a classic-style interior with a profusion of wood, square tables and a traditional lay out, plus an attractive summer terrace facing the sea. The well-balanced menu offers plenty of choice, including tasting options and an à la carte, all of which showcase carefully prepared meat and fish dishes. In season, truffles add their unique flavour to various dishes – we particularly enjoyed them served with pumpkin and prawns, as well as in the Mediterranean sea bass dish. An excellent wine list completes the picture....
